notes.mathematics_led_reading: Read all indices, signs, hats, joins and relations locally. The rightmost E index in the brace is alpha (crop08); the final lower union index reads alpha in K1 despite clipping at the sheet edge (crop14). No expression was repaired from an expected argument. No theorem or proof was checked.
notes.sigma_heads: Crop03 and crop06 show the plain and roofed Sigma forms with a separated horizontal head and lower zigzag. Roofed occurrences retain widehat; plain occurrences retain Sigma. This page’s upper strokes were read as local handwriting components, without adding a closure operation.
notes.boundary_limits: First-line numeral 1 reaches the physical right boundary; punctuation beyond it cannot be recovered. Final K1 lower index reaches the physical bottom boundary; its visible parts support K1. Crop13 includes part of the long descender belonging to que on the preceding line, retained through that existing word rather than duplicated as a new mark.
